records.title: Favorite artists and music preferences
records.publicText: Mark’s favorite artists include Drake, Lil Baby, Tory Lanez, The Weeknd, Don Toliver, Travis Scott, and PARTYNEXTDOOR. He enjoys rap, melodic hip-hop, and R&B, ranging from energetic and confident tracks to darker, atmospheric, reflective music. That preference fits the cinematic, high-contrast visual atmosphere used in his portfolio. Music is part of how Mark trains, reflects, travels, and stays connected to particular moments or moods. Do not invent favorite albums or songs, quote lyrics, claim Mark knows an artist personally, claim an artist endorses Mark, or imitate an artist’s style.

records.title: Favorite films, animated series, and superhero worlds
records.publicText: Some of Mark’s favorite films are Creed, Creed II, The Batman, and Magazine Dreams. Regular Show is one of his favorite animated series and should not be classified as a movie. He also enjoys Marvel and DC movies, characters, and story worlds, including heroes, character arcs, visual design, and major film stories. He does not claim to have seen every release. He is drawn to stories involving ambition, transformation, discipline, pressure, identity, setbacks, sacrifice, and becoming stronger. Creed and Creed II connect to training, ambition, resilience, and earned progress. The Batman fits his preference for dark, cinematic, serious, high-contrast environments. Magazine Dreams connects to his interest in bodybuilding-centered character stories. Regular Show reflects a more relaxed and humorous side of his entertainment interests. If asked Marvel or DC, he enjoys both unless a stronger preference is later approved.
records.shortText: Favorite films: Creed, Creed II, The Batman, Magazine Dreams. Favorite animated series: Regular Show. Enjoys both Marvel and DC story worlds.

records.title: Lifestyle hobbies outside technology
records.publicText: Outside technology, Mark’s recruiter-facing public interests include fitness and bodybuilding, travel, photography, hiking, reading, music, cities, architecture, landscapes, museums, classical statues and art, Greek mythology, running, and cinematic visual design. He describes fitness as a source of discipline, structure, patience, and consistency. Photography helps him document places, cities, architecture, and landscapes that give him a new perspective. Travel and hiking combine exploration, scenery, and reflection. Music and reading remain general public interests without naming private preferences. Do not mention pets, family routines, private relationships, favorite artists, favorite colors, or other unpublished personal details.

records.title: Public travel places shown in the portfolio
records.publicText: Places intentionally shown in Mark’s public portfolio travel data include Hawaii, Las Vegas, Chicago, California, Lake Louise in Canada, Manila in the Philippines, London, the Amalfi Coast in Italy, Rome in Italy, Milwaukee, and Nashville. The Webpage Travel section and Terminal travel files present these public places and related travel photography. Travel helps Mark experience different environments, people, cultures, architecture, and ways of living. It gives him new perspectives and motivates greater freedom and independence. Cities connect to ambition, energy, architecture, and progress. Water and coastal environments connect to peace. Mountains and hiking connect to effort, challenge, and earning the view. Photography helps preserve the feeling and story of a place. Do not infer current residence, invent favorite destinations, invent trip companions, or expose itineraries, lodging, flights, or exact private schedules.
